name: Question 16
problem:
$$
{x}^{′}(t)=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}]x(t)+[\begin{aligned}-{t}^{2}-2t+2 \\ -3{t}^{2}+5t-1\end{aligned}],\,x(0)=[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -7\end{aligned}]
$$

Find the missing coefficients in the solution to the initial value problem, shown above.

worked_solution:
We are told that the general solution to the system is 

$$
x(t)={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}{e}^{-t} \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ {e}^{3t}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-{t}^{2}+2 \\ {t}^{2}-t\end{aligned}]
$$

where ${c}_{1},{c}_{2}$ are constants that are to be determined. 

Next, we find the values of ${c}_{1}$ and ${c}_{2}.$ Substituting $t=0$ into the general solution, we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}x(0) & =[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -7\end{aligned}] \\ {c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}{e}^{-(0)} \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ {e}^{3(0)}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-(0)^{2}+2 \\ (0)^{2}-0\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -7\end{aligned}] \\ {c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -7\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{c}_{1}+2 \\ {c}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -7\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have the following system of linear equations:

$$
{\begin{aligned}{c}_{1}+2=8 \\ {c}_{2}=-7\end{aligned}
$$

From the first equation, we get ${c}_{1}=6.$ From the second equation, we have ${c}_{2}=-7.$

Therefore, the solution to the initial value problem is

$$
x(t)=6\cdot [\begin{aligned}{e}^{-t} \\ 0\end{aligned}]-7\cdot [\begin{aligned}0 \\ {e}^{3t}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-{t}^{2}+2 \\ {t}^{2}-t\end{aligned}].
$$
